Display Transformers palettes

Source: R/show.R
tf_show_palettes.Rd

Draws a swatch strip for each palette on the current graphics device, labeled with the palette name and, by default, the hex code under each swatch. Useful for picking a character or for reporting a color that looks wrong. With no arguments every toy palette is drawn, which is a lot; filter by faction, team, role or use to narrow it down, or pass a character's palettes across media to compare them.

Usage

tf_show_palettes(
  names = NULL,
  faction = NULL,
  team = NULL,
  role = NULL,
  use = NULL,
  medium = "toy",
  ncol = 3,
  hex = TRUE
)

Arguments

names

Optional character vector of palette names to show. Defaults to every palette matching the other filters.

faction

Optional faction to restrict to; see tf_factions().

team

Optional combiner team to restrict to; see tf_teams().

role

Optional role to restrict to; see tf_palette_names().

use

Optional use case to restrict to; see tf_find_palettes().

medium

Which medium's palettes to show: "toy" (default), "cartoon", "comic" or "all". Ignored when names is given.

ncol

Number of columns to arrange the swatch strips in.

hex

Logical. Print the hex code under each swatch?

Value

Invisibly, the character vector of palette names that were drawn.

Examples

tf_show_palettes(team = "Aerialbots")

tf_show_palettes(team = "Aerialbots", medium = "cartoon")

tf_show_palettes(faction = "Decepticon", role = "combined form", ncol = 2)

tf_show_palettes(use = "colorblind", ncol = 4)

tf_show_palettes(c("megatron", "megatron_cartoon", "megatron_comic"), ncol = 1)
